messages:
riley: Quick ask — can someone run a short side-by-side latency snapshot across A100 / H100 / L40S for r-davinci-1?
I just need a concise table with median, p95, p99 for two seq lengths (2k and 32k) and batch sizes 1,4,16. Also include kernel/driver and whether quant (fp16/int8) was used. No need for long writeup, just numbers + any obvious outliers. Thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: What precision do you want tested? fp16 baseline and int8 optional? Also which image tag — latest-runtime or stable-2026-02?

riley: fp16 baseline please. If int8 is supported on the SKU, add it as a second column but mark as optional. Use stable-2026-02 for parity with recent runs.

jamie: quick note — use the replay trace for latency shapes, not synthetic tokens. Command I usually run:```
bench-run --model r-davinci-1 --seq-lens 2048,32768 --batches 1,4,16 --precision fp16 --warmup 150 --runtime-image redwood/runtime:stable-2026-02 --report p50,p95,p99 --output /tmp/bench-$(hostname)-$(date +%s).json
```
That keeps numbers comparable to previous sweeps.

marta: Heads up — test cluster drivers are on 525.60 but some dev racks still have 515.xx. If you need perfectly apples-to-apples, pick machines in the "perf-pool" tag (they're all on 525.60). Also L40S on perf-pool has ECC off which changed tail behavior last month.

riley: Good call, tag perf-pool then. Can @sam or @jamie pick machines there? Also please drop raw artifacts to the bench-share bucket.

sam: I'll spin this up tonight on perf-pool. Will run fp16 across all three SKUs; if int8 is available I'll do a follow-up. Will post the quick CSV here when ready. ETA ~6-8h. :eyes:

bench-bot: Job scheduled: bench-1768001234-01 on perf-pool (A100,H100,L40S). Estimated runtime 3h per SKU, parallelized. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://bench-share/1768001234/ when complete.

riley: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything flares (thermal, memory OOMs), just post error output here and we can triage.

jamie: tiny tip: add `--kv-cache=false` to isolate compute latency if you're running against cached responses; avoids misleading p50 improvements.

sam: noted. I'll include both cached and cold runs and label them. Will ping perf-oncall if tails look weird.

marta: Also capture `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv -l 5` during run for thermal context.

sam: will do. Posting results here when done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
